Name: wetfarts busty gothic abigail for 1.6
Author: yugiboy9001
Description:
This is my first mod uploaded to nexus and it really isnt mine. i just added to it and made it usable for 1.6. wetfart hasn't been on nexus for 2-3 years now i think so if he wants me to take this down i will. also if nexus gets upset with this i'll also take it down with no resistance so please don't ban me.

now that that's said i've added some personal tweaks but for the most part its the same and the pixel art i added isnt even close to as good as what wetfart did originally so don't download this expecting perfection as i made this for myself and decided to share. speaking of which some of the winter sprites are untouched as i've married abigail a ton of times and don't recall when they were used so i left them be but if they're important and i'm blind i could fix that idk. I also added lipstick to the sprite that im kinda iffy on so let me know if i should add a optional file without it... if this is even still up.

Downloads.Description: fixed the white background in the winter sprite and stopped the winter sprite from moonwalking.

Manifest.Name: Busty Gothic Abigail
Manifest.Description: Gives Abigail black lipstick and eyeliner, an elegant black dress, longer hair with bat bows, and big boobs. Includes portrait and sprite.
